## myColorado App Offline after Data Breach
Colorado took its myColorado app offline after an unauthorized user accessed platform data, a breach the [state discovered late Nov. 18](https://email.editor.thecoloradoflyover.com/c/eJykkL-OhCAYxJ8GO4wgohQU19jttVca_nyuJAgGvl3j21-8ZJ_g2t9kJjPz81geJsSQnt9mB41uXRKcNQIilMUnZ4Pfc4Ir5oqYC-ZQwaSFd1xSxigfFuMwvGERpvF6XbkzsgHNRjVIxkbGm033jisl-m6SA7OD8JJJYeUE1knhpIUm6DuPMT6wvmNCtTBOYKfVdMyoQTFFRAc-YC4tbuByzMX4vMYrv6G0Lu9N1BviUUn_RfhM-HyeZ-tsvbfcOuHzx0X4fFPC5_36MGqOg9bthdTnM9GjZASH1Bs01F0WSgX3KgEvGpILHhISPjdF--MMMYYqRyK6525C_CuD__zxrflvAAAA__-3a4sr). The app remains down during a busy travel week. The state estimates the incident may have exposed data from as many as 150,000 of the app's [roughly 2.1 million users](https://email.editor.thecoloradoflyover.com/c/eJykkD2upDAQhE9jMo9og_kJHGxC9jbdEDV2e6YlYyPTb0bcfsVK7wSblVSfqkr152v9Qk6cn79xJyc-rpk-ZyIRqmvIfuOwl0xXKqdIqVL4JMyrac2gAbSxK3rhN609NsHFaDwODTkYZzsAjGCal5vAAlI_25Y2H6PFtrPW92OH0xC7sWvY3XkAxkLXQj8_aJxomyK2gLOdYVZ9S4Gl1Ie8yJdUKoYS01XeVB--7E1yL5HjVN0vZRZllh_m_M63r8xyNyizANy6V2bZrx9IB36yYNIcNB6HDuWTtb82qvok_11ZLs3Zc6AsyixNdeH4cEp8DqPq2-eOnP6tkP888O3M3wAAAP__cDaF4Q). Officials have not said what kinds of data were accessed. Many Coloradans use the app as a digital ID at [TSA airport checkpoints](https://email.editor.thecoloradoflyover.com/c/eJykkLGqrjAQhJ9GO8WNRk2R4jZ2_21vKWuy-Q1EV-LeX3z7gwfOE5xmGBj4mJl_r_mFMcX9_Rc3suLCvNN1JhKhPPvdLdFvvNOd-BThLBxPwn1WjeorgErpGZ3ED80dlt6GoBz2JVkYjO4BBlDlaqE1fmgG3_ZOB2wQTViUHtsWR4fL2JbRPjwApaFtoDM1DSMtY8AG0GgDpuga8lE417KS48QZPYd084dy7Xgrk11FjrNo_xRqKtR0XVd948r8pIWanlGFmv4_glmiS_TY7f6BVRsvMVGFx1FxCCnuVHkUrGDQRhltTL3Klsps_XHFlOLZD0XXvDeM6buB_PK8j1VfAQAA__9FqIU6), so officials are urging Thanksgiving travelers to carry a physical license or state ID instead. State services remain available through agency websites, and affected users will be notified. The state has not given a timeline for restoring the app.
## Denver Sets Aside $40M for DNC
Denver City Council voted 9-2 Monday to approve a [$40 million reimbursable grant](https://email.editor.thecoloradoflyover.com/c/eJykkL3u2zAMxJ9G3hyY9Fc8aOjiLV07GrREJQJk0ZBZB3n7wukj_DcSd_fD4f48lgfFFPPzN21s1YUl8_tIrMpl8dmt0W-S-ZPkUJWiEg-mvGCDQw1QY7-Q03jy0lHlbQjoaKjYwjj1A8AIWL0sw4pT4KHFhoIHv45h7MBNEBpGBKqivXgA2EPbQDfdeLzzeg_UAE39BJPpGvZRpdz0xU6SFPIS0kdOLjcnW5XsS3U_TPvL4Gxw9pxPLlH5Ug3OF9_gDHDd7dewiSuk0dWZNEqmVDvJJ-frqf_n6_A3-5ifNe17kZO9wbkq1u_vmFI8htF0zXOjmL4d9IfznRb_BQAA__8IaIXu) backing its bid for the 2028 Democratic National Convention. Councilmembers Stacie Gilmore and Shontel Lewis voted no. The money comes from [Downtown Development Authority](https://email.editor.thecoloradoflyover.com/c/eJykkL3unDAQxJ8GOiN7j8_CRRq6S5sSLfYaVjI2sn2ge_uI5BH-3Ug_zWhm_ryXN7LnsP3Gg3Qxbgl0Z0-lUFpsMCvbIwb6-phLialEzoRhAQm9UEpAt6ApfNHSYm21c2Cwr0mrYep6pQYF9a7lROsAxo0S-5YQjCKwBtzoOmjd2tasnzyloFMvqdqpoWGkdXQoFU7dpKaqlWS5xNSUnUz0MaGNzn_jRakx8ai93ks5c_X6VcFcwXzfd2MpXJSGh1cwP7MqmM_oubB55H8uTPwEw17geaZ4URYHe88xZIFZOA4YDKMX2wcThkIk7p09ievLYRMuJgESRmGDqZO25_2Ycz9UrdwOZP-vXfnhsZeGvwEAAP__AE2Rng) tax revenue and serves as a financial guarantee, which state party chair Shad Murib said every host city must provide. Under the [proposed grant agreement](https://email.editor.thecoloradoflyover.com/c/eJykkDGu3SAURFdjd1iADZiCIs3rftqU1gUu30gYnuDK1t999LKFlCONRnPOn6_jC3LJ9fs3XOgopKPiMwoSYT9iDT7Hq1X8KW0QtU4tD4R6SC41E4JJdUCgfOOxwRxdSjKAntEJY5UWwgg5ny54I_S682S9SkassEvukXsbVxWjsHN2nz0hpBIrF5td0Ozo9wRcgFVW2GnjGDO1vtCJoZXWIbZUftqNfQntmos7id5jWn9N8jXJ1_M8S_BD2A_NpzHJV8R6Y2fwfvd242Abv5jPkVFjZxvEIl6DVaDcKhQWWr2xfsIkX9Aph4IH31TgPmqmfdJMca6YDSswrWQwypg9GbWcdJW5u_h-cil5aDNt_PuCXP49pf-UfDv5NwAA__9DHpFO), the host committee could tap the money only if fundraising falls short, and unused funds must be returned by Dec. 31, 2030. Denver, Boston, and Philadelphia are the three finalists for the 2028 convention. If chosen, Denver would host the event for the first time since 2008.
## Family Offers Reward for Missing Tortoise
A New Castle family is offering a $1,500 reward for the safe return of Rafael, a 100-pound African sulcata tortoise who wandered through an open gate Nov. 18. Tim and Jacquie Finholm said 30-year-old Rafael often roams their neighborhood, but they are worried because [his species doesn't hibernate](https://email.editor.thecoloradoflyover.com/c/eJykkDHOnTAQhE8DnRH2AwOFizSv-9OmRGt792FpwQhvQNw-IlFO8FczxWg08_36mr8gcdo-P2FFJ4HmDa_CKILHHLfgU1zzhjfnIpIPyakgbLNpjVVaK9PPECSdOHdQR0dkAtganR6m3mo9aFMvzndhIhq0tb73FOIInabRGx27obcvqpN7-rQ2vX61upsaHEb0I0GrYeonPVVdizFJPhpZMGTOB8RMfOcTjybktWa3iOylev2ozLsy7-u6Gig7bhES38-lJ1aZ92P_iQpQhFERrIlvtTNCLIryofbfnlMoakHelWRFaYvKI-cTo9pR1H8Qqm_RDgRUHy7uV2JOxQ5V135WSPx3mHyT6enMnwAAAP__RSWP9g) and needs warmth. The family said the battery in Rafael's device was [recently replaced](https://email.editor.thecoloradoflyover.com/c/eJykkL3O4yAQRZ8Gd1jMxH8UFNu4y7ZbWtgMCRJmLGCD8varrJQn-Pqro3vOn_t2tyGG9PhtTzL18FuiViLVSnlz6diDOznRO3KplXPlUMimDRVOEkDiuNmjhhdtg-2c8R4PO3VkYNbjBDADdk-jcFpgQdh3q8fbsGuvPWi1qEWRXnDqgvnwAHCEm4JB9zQvtC_eKrB61KDFoMiFyrmvTzo4craOfXzzi3J_8NlF86z1KuL2S-AqcG2t9Y1KpZxK5IsSt89O4PrRE7h-IdLbM8S3ZO8pFwmjUjJTs9lJz1meoZSQHhKUkhf_TU5-Iwhcu2zc1UKMoUyzGNTjtCH-v1N_WPJl8F8AAAD__9RWij4), so they suspect someone picked him up and removed it or that the device was damaged. Volunteers have searched for Rafael with a tracking dog and even a helicopter. The family says it will honor the reward for his safe return with no questions asked.

clean_body: This is a clarion cry to stay vigilant against anti-democracy forces. | Formerly All On The Line Peter, Election Day’s in the rearview mirror. It’s about to be time to govern and the defenders of democracy face two choices: stick to the ugly status quo, or boldly pursue the systemic reforms that the American people are crying out for. The choice is clear. Redistricting Action is doing everything we can to advance a strong, pro-democracy agenda. Attorney General Eric Holder recently warned us all against becoming complacent at this moment of peril: "If we retreat into caution, if we operate out of fear, if we take refuge in the niceties of the old Washington and seek approval from those who have been and are actively dismantling our institutions, we will fail." —A.G. Holder It's a clarion cry to stay vigilant. We’re still up against extreme politicians who’ve been manipulating maps to try to thwart the American people. Just look at what Mississippi is trying to do in lame duck... We’re still facing anti-democracy forces who gutted the Voting Rights Act to rip fair representation away from communities of color. body:
Peter, you can't move the Shore, and you probably don't want to leave it. So the common sense move is making sure you're not paying a single dollar more than you legally owe on everything else.

Peter, New Jersey gave the world the boardwalk, Bruce Springsteen, and the best bagels on the planet...(sorry, New York, it's true) It also gave its residents some of the highest property taxes in America. You can't move the Shore, and you probably don't want to leave it. So the common sense move is making sure you're not paying a single dollar more than you legally owe on everything else. That's exactly what we're talking about in **Red Bank on Thursday, December 3rd,** at our final wealth-building and tax savings event of the year. [Reserve your seat here](https://xtz223.keap-link013.com/v2/click/86fc759afb3183f08eef48869c622200/eJyNkN9rgzAQgP-XPJtajdopjCGlFLHrw9ieR2pODGoS4jnXFf_3xW7r0wZ7O-6---7HhSAorrAQJCPv-BGGjHjEQiWNBIVbrZBX12oYRwELPNJJ1e6tHg3JLr8234AlHQQsiTyCZwOOeX7Kt2Vx3L8eimPpUMOtG_IvUbpO726e3WNeHMg8_ymGXuLuzbkHkqEdYTlJSHcWvtjO8Q2iGTLfn6ZpBQt3shJhVeneB7_nLdBeW6AtgPmKsAEKSlBd0zNwSyfgHTb01I1grFRIrxaKsmoBBxqu11HCGEtStgkeeF3fayFQYGWBo7ZuQ26M833_t4Tzz55yGEYQuXtKsEnjJEzTOJ4_ASPWi0QBFMJhj7ttSvqCeT5FVoncSQ==) The day is built around 3 pillars: Make more Keep more Build more Rob and the Tru-Fit Tax & Planning team will walk through how proactive tax planning can uncover ways to legally lower what you owe. Rob has completed more than 23,000 cash flow analyses, and he has a knack for finding money people didn't know they were leaving on the table. Bill, a voice many of you have trusted for years, joins Rob, along with entrepreneur Dave Meltzer, to talk about building success that lasts well beyond your income, and about protecting the health it takes to enjoy it. Whether you run a business or simply want to keep more of your paycheck, this day was built for you. Bring a spouse or a business partner who should hear it too. ## Holiday Travel Rush Hits Arizona
Tucson International Airport expects [144,000 passengers](https://email.editor.thearizonaflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOpCAUhZ8GOwwgoBYU29jNtluaK16VDIIB1N15-o3zCn93Tk7y5eT78xpf4LwL62_Y0RT4LGPAO3ssBdMIOyZnIU9ndpiLCyGeBW4Io2BCU86pUCPY4i4cJVSzabTtW1mh4W2vNOe9UtVmtGVy0h1MFhfQEsF2XM22U4ttOOugcubhcS4Ub5hSshYwcSEXpfulaTlKIhnOrsRUlw0huU8MsPh_8cJU27hX3mylHJk0v4gYiBju-67f0c_PSMTw0IkYOH-yJGIop80xUHDpiKlQ_HugLZlyKRlj9ICcMayYMp3P5MJKywbhnVd3fUuCCz1NZ96IGKpk5uN23rusWyLZuoPz31Plpz4vI_4HAAD__97Hi20) over Thanksgiving week, and AAA projects about 1.5 million Arizonans will hit the road, slightly more than last year. ADOT won't schedule [any full highway closures](https://email.editor.thearizonaflyover.com/c/eJyk0L3unDAQBPCngc4If0EoXKS57tKmRIu9wOqMfcIL6O7pI_IK_2q632jm73N8AkVKyx_Y0DF85zHhVSIy4z7Chjt5KNNRCAtTSvlguCCNqlWdkFIoO4JnOnE0UAenOz_0pkYn-8F2Ug7W1qtrlTa_2gA6gDZeT75XiGruwMt58gA1uduTUlmpW2tNo2CSysy2G2bdSzSVaTEQ573hFWGnb04wx08-cW983uroVuZ3qfTvSj0q9YBvyNws-azU495zRxaFgVGstKwXfISPuRw7FlH8iuGIGMTtCV4hvcpCJ6VFXIgvTKHeXXhfFCOVrq9Mu2xA8X8z__S006l_AQAA___JE4V4) from this afternoon through late Monday night, but expects heavy traffic on I-10 and on I-17 north of Phoenix. Drivers will find some relief at the pump. Arizona's average for regular is [about $3.90 a gallon](https://email.editor.thearizonaflyover.com/c/eJykkD2ypCAQx0-jGZYg4BgQbGI2m25otdpq1yJY0KOzc_otX70bvPz_-fvzHJ5AnsL6G3Z0DJ9lCHhlj8yYBtgx0QR5fGXCzBRCfDFcEAZVKyukFMoMMDGdOGgoZ9fYqWt1iU62nbFSdsaUm9OowbagG0Q7jmDnpVvqTltTa_VQj7Ykd-dJqYxsamN0pWCUSi_GdkvTStSFrnEmjqniDSHRJwZY_L94YqqmuJfebcxHLppfheoL1V_XVS3xLetjixjofYsK1d_XCtXzBuFvXumksApOcKIX6ZU3IUUrdvKeYhDfLSELfB84Mc5iIxYpwixWyOJINGEWc4pHmdx8XLcv27bQ9boD-a9d_FOkp1P_AwAA___Edo72), down roughly 15 cents from last week. Prices are still higher than last year, though. In Pima County, drivers paid an average of [$3.58 a gallon](https://email.editor.thearizonaflyover.com/c/eJyk0M2upCAQhuGrwR1GEPxZsJiNu57tLE21FFppBAO0zvTVTzw5d3B2b1LJk8r35zE_gDyF9TfsaAp83Bzwyh5LwTTDjokWyM93JsyFQojvAheEWTay40JwqWdYCp04K6isabtl7FWFRvSj7oQYta42A8Ji26hBO1RPhyhdb8elG8SA1rV2qMjcnhBSi7bRWtUSnkIqp7vRtb1AxVSDlkpMddkQEn1iAOf_xRNTvcS98mYr5cis_cXkxOR0XVf9it7eRyanW2dyEuJufVfPd_KeYuDfWsgc_x64FLS8JDjR87JBeOWVTgorXyHzI9GCmdsUDyanKhl7XLeSu56pZt2B_Nc35adDnkb-DwAA__9Oz4k5) Tuesday, more than 50 cents above a year ago. Sunday is expected to be among the busiest days on the roads and in the skies.
## Man Indicted in Substation Bombing
A 23-year-old faces [five felony charges](https://email.editor.thearizonaflyover.com/c/eJykkD2u2zAQhE8jdTTEP9EsWKRR57QphRW1shehSIFc24lP_2Dj3eDVM5jB9_25zBegRPn6G3YMDK9tzvhsCZmxzrBjpQhtuTfCxpRzuTM8Ic9qUKOQUig7Q2R64GygX4Meo3emxyCdt6OU3tr-FrzbzNlqr-Lg5dlo49CcrR_sovXiouspvPekVFbqwVpzUrBIZTY7-k07iaYzA67EpZ74hlDpVTJs6X95YD3Fsvcp3JiP1ulfnZo6Nf1l-ASdmr7b4o3VqWmHLCivFBlX0eoh8N-RSqOSxY4NxAoMImJmrH0N6_GklKiNrjPDdQdKnzv-qalHUF8BAAD___OIftI) after prosecutors say he set off a homemade bomb at a Salt River Project substation in Mesa that powers an Apple data center. Prosecutors say Xander McLendon broke into the substation near Elliot and Signal Butte roads on June 21 and was trying to install the device on [a breaker](https://email.editor.thearizonaflyover.com/c/eJyk0DHOnDAQQOHTQDcIG9uEwkUauj9tSjSY8eLE2MieXbScPtoUuUAu8PTp_fxavjDEkB4_8CDLePsl0VUjMVNZ8KASHNb1WQNVDinlJ-OFaZG9NCAESL2g4_CiRWG72cG4aVQtWTFO2ggxad3udlBTj9r0o1Bm7VHJ0ZPoxSD9Nn1Do9tgPz0hpBZDr7XqJK5CKq_N5IdRkGpUT1vgXDreCUu4c0If3_lFpXP5aKPdmc_aDN8bOTdyvq6r-_3rvrtcHo2cP_5EtTZy_gdXjZzxhgMTeHRUQYOnmNMb3I7lQRXQMxU4cwyOoOIbdgIugTbgDGvMFzxPqOWE-lwrI4ecwOcCGzKCo8RUalvsdl4hxlDN2Kj-cWCIf8n8v7dfVv4JAAD__6Nnlec) when it exploded. He was burned in the blast and [called 911 himself](https://email.editor.thearizonaflyover.com/c/eJykkD2unTAUhFdjOiP8hx-FizR0L21KdMDHcCRjI2wuuXf1EdnC66YYzXz6_nxP30CR0vobdnQVPmFKeJeIteI5wY4nLVDmqxCWSinlq8INaZKd7LkQXJoJlkovnDQ03ql-Gaxu0Ak7mF6IwZhmc18Wbddb_eWVWsQcjFIqDOAHtGC8Dw25Z08IaYTqjNGthFlIHUw_BGUFaqY79FTz2dYN4aRPThDiO7_wbJe8N9FttR6FqV9MjkyO93238AmwU3w_BSbH54HJUYgnaybHHRKn5Gmp6DnEiCv6-OYLXIXSyvHvEXOhnPhNdeOEnu9YgJfz4OWaS4VKOTE5Nqfzx00xUukt0926A8X_VPWnQl9O_gsAAP__X86MKA). SRP confirmed he wasn't an employee, and Mesa police investigated with the ATF and FBI. The explosion and fire caused [about $148,000 in damage](https://email.editor.thearizonaflyover.com/c/eJykkL_upCAURp9GOwwg-Keg2MZutt3SXOEy3gTBAI6z8_Sb2Vf49V--k3P-PNYHUKD4_A0Hmgofv0a8S8BaMa9wYCYLZbsKYakUY7oq3BBXyeXAhGBSr2ArvXBV0DrTD3YeVYtGjLMehJi1bnfD5eSUA-83OdppnNQ0c9crPugN-nESLZnvnxBSi55rrToJm5DK62H2_ShQNYqjo5pyV3eETJ8UwYe_6YW5s-log9lrPUvT_2rk0sjlvu_Op7fg554w0vs7auTyVWvkckBkYO1V0DELV6H4ZPg-QyqUIjuwACv5ZOXaSoVKKbbZuPOmEKgMY6P48wAK_8H1p81eRv4LAAD__-ykg5g). McLendon is being held on a $1 million bond, and his trial is set for March 10.
## Busiest In-N-Out Is in Tempe
The [busiest In-N-Out](https://email.editor.thearizonaflyover.com/c/eJykkDtuwzAQRE9DdTTEr6KCRRp1TptSWElLexGKMsiVhfj0gQ3fIPUMZvDe93k8AyXKly9YMTA84pjxqAmZsYywYqEZ6rRXwsqU87YzHJBH3WovlZLajTAz3XG00CzB-LnvbINBdb3zSvXONddgYvyYMPZOg1Z-Vt3ULvNiWm_8tFhrGgrPPaW0U6Z1zp40TErb6HwfTafQCtviQryVE18RCj22DDH9bncsp3lbmxSuzLcqzKfQg9DDD8MrEHp4t2XByrAXyCyfhEIPlGWW285y2ssFi3xTSsb1hk0Jy-2glKj6Ttj2sgKl1xf_V9M96L8AAAD__8pRfxA) in the country isn't in California. It's in Tempe. name: Caitlin Cattelino
subject: Take Action: Tell your Representative to vote NO on BAAJA
body:
BAAJA is headed for a House vote. Urge your Representative to reject this assault on the Endangered Species Act!
BAAJA is headed for a House vote. Urge your Representative to reject this assault on the Endangered Species Act!
| [](https://support.defenders.org/s/6363964/38SyG9Xl)
---
| | |
---
#
Defender, _Earlier this week, my colleague, Chris, urged you to contact your Representative about opposing BAAJA, the permitting bill that unfortunately passed the Senate._ _I wanted to echo Chris's request and also provide you with some additional resources and actions to take._[**_Our BAAJA Advocacy Toolkit_**](https://support.defenders.org/s/6363965/38SyG9Xl) _includes background information, a sample call script and a letter to the editor template._**_Any action you can take is critical as we understand the vote in the House could be as early as next week!_** _If you have any questions, need additional resources, or would like an extra set of eyes to review your message to your Representative, please feel free to reach out._ **_Imperiled wildlife are depending on us. We must do all we can to protect them. Your voice, passion and action can make a difference!_** _Thank you for all that you do,_ _Caitlin, Director of National Outreach_
#
|
---
[](https://support.defenders.org/s/6363966/38SyG9Xl)
---
| | |
---
#
|
---
[SIGN NOW: Tell the House to Keep Threatened and Endangered Animals Protected!](https://support.defenders.org/s/6363967/38SyG9Xl)
---
| | |
---
#
Defender,
#
**The House is about to decide the fate of America’s imperiled wildlife, and your voice is needed right now!**
#
[**Will your Representative defend the Endangered Species Act, or help bulldoze it?**](https://support.defenders.org/s/6363968/38SyG9Xl) If we don’t speak up now, wolves, grizzly bears, sea turtles and countless other imperiled species could pay the price.
#
The Senate has now passed the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act of 2026 (BAAJA), and it is headed to the House. Don’t let the name fool you: this bill is one of the most damaging attacks on wildlife we have ever seen. **If it becomes law, it will rewrite the ESA, our country’s strongest tool for protecting wildlife and preventing extinction, in profound and dangerous ways.**
#
**Here’s the good news: the House can still stop this. Your Representative can vote NO on final passage of BAAJA.**
#
[**The House vote could come at any moment, so there is no time to lose! Send an urgent message now and call on your Representative to protect endangered wildlife by voting NO.**](https://support.defenders.org/s/6363969/38SyG9Xl)
#
|
---
[TELL YOUR REPRESENTATIVE: VOTE NO!](https://support.defenders.org/s/6363970/38SyG9Xl)
---
| | |
---
#
**What makes BAAJA so dangerous? Plenty.**
#
* It will **cut federal wildlife scientists out of decisions** about projects that threaten endangered animals, removing a critical safeguard against extinction.
* It will **leave endangered animals extremely vulnerable** by shifting conservation responsibilities to underfunded, understaffed state agencies.
* It will **weaken protections across the country** by gutting the national system for protecting endangered species, replacing it with a patchwork of **_up to 50 different state processes,_** leaving wildlife with dangerously inconsistent protections.
* It will completely **exempt some highway and water projects from endangered species requirements** and never even ask the question whether the project might jeopardize the existence of threatened or endangered species-- effectively creating two **God Squads without the squad!**

#
**Worse still, Congress is racing to push these sweeping changes through in a lame-duck session, before newly elected members even take their seats and have a say.**
#
|
---
[TELL YOUR REPRESENTATIVE: VOTE NO!](https://support.defenders.org/s/6363971/38SyG9Xl)
---
| | |
---
#
The evidence is clear: the ESA is not the roadblock to development that its opponents claim it is. BAAJA would weaken core wildlife protections while ignoring the real problems that slow projects down.
#
The ESA has saved more than 99% of listed species from extinction. We can’t let a rushed vote tear it down.
#
[**Your Representative can still choose wildlife over this rushed bill. Make sure they hear from YOU today: tell them to vote NO on BAAJA.**](https://support.defenders.org/s/6363972/38SyG9Xl)
#
Thank you for standing up for threatened and endangered animals.
#
Sincerely,
#
|

---
| **Chris Westfall** Sr. Government Relations Legislative Counsel
Defenders of Wildlife

Thank you for all that you do, Caitlin, Director of National Outreach | | | | | | | | Defender, The House is about to decide the fate of America’s imperiled wildlife, and your voice is needed right now! If we don’t speak up now, wolves, grizzly bears, sea turtles and countless other imperiled species could pay the price. The Senate has now passed the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act of 2026 (BAAJA), and it is headed to the House. Don’t let the name fool you: this bill is one of the most damaging attacks on wildlife we have ever seen. If it becomes law, it will rewrite the ESA, our country’s strongest tool for protecting wildlife and preventing extinction, in profound and dangerous ways. Here’s the good news: the House can still stop this. Your Representative can vote NO on final passage of BAAJA. | | | | What makes BAAJA so dangerous? Plenty. It will cut federal wildlife scientists out of decisions about projects that threaten endangered animals, removing a critical safeguard against extinction. It will leave endangered animals extremely vulnerable by shifting conservation responsibilities to underfunded, understaffed state agencies. It will weaken protections across the country by gutting the national system for protecting endangered species, replacing it with a patchwork of up to 50 different state processes, leaving wildlife with dangerously inconsistent protections. It will completely exempt some highway and water projects from endangered species requirements and never even ask the question whether the project might jeopardize the existence of threatened or endangered species-- effectively creating two God Squads without the squad! Worse still, Congress is racing to push these sweeping changes through in a lame-duck session, before newly elected members even take their seats and have a say. | | | | The evidence is clear: the ESA is not the roadblock to development that its opponents claim it is. BAAJA would weaken core wildlife protections while ignoring the real problems that slow projects down. The ESA has saved more than 99% of listed species from extinction. We can’t let a rushed vote tear it down. Thank you for standing up for threatened and endangered animals. Sincerely, | | | Chris Westfall Sr. Government Relations Legislative Counsel Defenders of Wildlife | | Defenders of Wildlife 1130 17th Street NW • Washington, DC 20036 * Photo Credit: Gray Wolf © kjekol/iStockphoto

My name is James O'Keefe. I'm an undercover journalist, and a
prosecutor in Minnesota has charged me with two felonies.

hidden-camera report on how Minnesota's voter “vouching” law
works. NO OATH WAS SIGNED. NO BALLOT WAS ISSUED. NO VOTE WAS CAST. The
prosecutor herself said it is “pretty clear” we did not intend to
vote. Still, the two counts together carry up to 10 years in prison
and $20,000 in fines.

showed up.

I stood before a judge in Minneapolis on November 16 while the charges
were read. The case is now pending, and I'm due back in court in
January.

your identity “in applying for a ballot.” I never asked for a
ballot or signed anything. The complaint relies on a state election
manual to argue otherwise, and my attorneys can ask the judge to throw
these charges out.

Then, if it comes to it: trial.

My name is James O'Keefe. I'm an undercover journalist, and a prosecutor in Minnesota has charged me with two felonies.

The charges are unlawful voting and identity theft. They stem from a hidden-camera report on how Minnesota's voter “vouching” law works. No oath was signed. No ballot was issued. No vote was cast. The prosecutor herself said it is “pretty clear” we did not intend to vote. Still, the two counts together carry up to 10 years in prison and $20,000 in fines.

On November 16, I stood before a judge in Minneapolis. Since then, people keep asking me, “James, what happens now?” So here is where things stand, and the road ahead, with no spin.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNzEsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAABFNVeSeCrgFItfFxjYToOJMzk0-rTmgjycs7M41V1wdXnLHeWMarf-WrOAHadT_ktdbBoqzptbfFsR5mU5dwFK6YNn3beeXnhNjA4cs4

It ordered me to appear in Minneapolis and warned, in capital letters, that if I didn't, “a WARRANT FOR YOUR ARREST shall be issued.” I showed up.

Done: the first appearance.

I stood before a judge in Minneapolis on November 16 while the charges were read. The case is now pending, and I'm due back in court in January.

Next: the hearings, starting in January.

This is where many cases are won or lost. The law bars misrepresenting your identity “in applying for a ballot.” I never asked for a ballot or signed anything. The complaint relies on a state election manual to argue otherwise, and my attorneys can ask the judge to throw these charges out.

Then, if it comes to it: trial.

If the state won't drop this, we go before a jury, with weeks of preparation and witnesses.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNzEsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAABFNVeSeEGKpTIv9SvVPnfFuNKjm0JpORGGse5pAEjmCTeamd9J4AeTCQkds2gZ5pGn9rntYwOPxrH5PbHN4kXe8onOAhtxuka6arp0QX
CHIP IN $35 — O'KEEFE DEFENSE FUND HOSTED BY LIBERTY GUARD →

01Minnesota defense lawyers who know these courts.

04Investigators to go through every frame of footage.
05Trial prep, if it comes to that.

A full felony defense through trial can run into six figures.

The state doesn't have to worry about any of that, because it has an entire office of prosecutors paid for by taxpayers.

I have you.

YES, I'LL HELP COVER JAMES'S LEGAL COSTS — DONATE NOW →

Patriot, this is how lawfare works. The government doesn't have to win. It only has to make the fight so long and so expensive that the defendant runs out of money or gives up.

I'm not giving up. But I can't pay for this alone.

In Truth,

James O'Keefe

subject: Trump + Nvidia is textbook corruption
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
This kind of self-dealing is exactly what voters are fed up with.
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=4170%2E21716%2ElPXn0x)
Earlier this month, voters elected Democrats with a mandate to crack down on corruption in Washington — **and Trump’s actions regarding Nvidia this week are the perfect example of why.**
[](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20261125-1.wrsnpk&refcode=em20261125-4170&t=2&akid=4170%2E21716%2ElPXn0x)
After Nvidia stock fell sharply this week following Jensen Huang’s ouster as CEO, Donald Trump (who has personally invested tens of millions of dollars in the company) used his influence to push for Huang’s reinstatement.
This kind of self-dealing is exactly what voters are fed up with, and it’s incumbent upon all of us in Congress to hold Trump — and every official engaged in corruption — accountable when we take the majority in January.
Here in Delaware, I’ve sat at too many kitchen tables with families who are doing everything right and still struggling to get by. They work extra shifts, cut back at the grocery store, and even put off doctor’s visits so they can make rent. When their savings take a hit, there’s no one in the Oval Office stepping in to save their investments.
With Trump, it’s one set of rules for the billionaires, and another set of rules for everyone else.
That’s why accountability is so important to me. **It’s about making sure the people with power in our country are working for families like yours, not for their own portfolios.**
I’m ready to do that work in January. But the people who profit from this kind of corruption have deep pockets, and they’re already gearing up to protect their influence. I need grassroots supporters like you standing with me to fight back.
[**Will you chip in $5 right now to help me keep standing up for working families in Congress?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20261125-1.wrsnpk&refcode=em20261125-4170&amount=5&t=3&akid=4170%2E21716%2ElPXn0x)

Sarah McBride

On September 10, 2025, Charlie Kirk was shot dead at a folding table on a Utah college campus, mid-debate, doing the one thing that made his movement work: standing in front of young people and asking for their vote. Thirteen months later, the exit polls delivered his eulogy in reverse and _nobody is talking about it_. Democrats won the House 259-176 and the Senate 56-44, flipping nine Republican-held seats -- including Kansas, which hadn't elected a Democrat in a century. The party's worst midterm in a generation. But the autopsy isn't in the seat counts. It's in two numbers that should frighten _every_ Republican operative in Washington.
**Number one** : voters under 30 backed House Democrats 66 to 31. In 2024, that same cohort split roughly down the middle for Trump. _A 35-point swing in 24 months_.
**Number two** : in the 343 counties the Washington Post calls evangelical hubs, turnout ran at just 66 percent of 2024 levels. White evangelicals were 17 percent of the electorate -- _down from a quarter_ in the presidential year -- and evangelical leaders took to social media to publicly scold their own flocks for not showing up. The 82 percent who did vote stayed loyal. The problem is the pews were empty.
The faithful didn't defect. They vanished. And the young didn't drift right -- they came home. That is not a messaging failure. That is what happens when a movement loses the one man who was making its voters, and assumes the machine will run itself.

**November 25, 2026**
"To care for him who shall have borne the battle, and for his widow, and his orphan."
Abraham Lincoln spoke these words in his Second Inaugural Address in 1865, as the Civil War was drawing to a close.
More than a century and a half later, they still remind us that service does not end when someone comes home, and sacrifice does not end when someone does not.
Today, we give thanks to the veterans among us and remember those who are no longer here. We recognize those who carried the uniform, those who carried the memories, and the families who carried the worry and waited for them to return.
Some came home. Some did not. All deserve our gratitude.
To every veteran, living and departed, and to the families who stood beside them: thank you.
Your service is part of the story of this country, and it is our responsibility to ensure that sacrifice is never forgotten.
**Pause.
Breathe.
Look Deeper.**
**Refuel.**
**Welcome to Sweet Ground.**

| Hi Peter,

It's Thanksgiving weekend, which means it's time for a yearly tradition: arguing with your "pro-life" uncle about why women deserve basic human rights!

Maybe it's not your uncle. Maybe it's an aunt, a grandpa, or a second cousin once removed who can't stop complaining about abortion and cheering on cruel bans.

Next time they bring it up, try this: [Women in states with abortion bans are nearly twice as likely to die during pregnancy.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/144028812/662195929/2083279013?sourceid=1151747&utm_campaign=27emkge-1108aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=thanksgiving&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MzE3ZGIzYy1lMGU4LWYxMTEtOTFmMy0wMDBkM2E1MzMxOWIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=naFatQ-FubS_dcIAVUDXiLK7XBzIZ9q5zi9pArTIMmg=&emci=474e0e54-cde6-f111-91f3-000d3a533978&emdi=7317db3c-e0e8-f111-91f3-000d3a53319b&ceid=954237) That's a real, deadly fact. But your cousin who gets all his news from podcast bros probably won't care.

We know how to win arguments at the Center. We do it all the time in courtrooms around the world. That's why we know the best way to win is by taking action.

So skip the shouting match. Show your anti-rights relatives exactly what you believe in. subject: Thank you, Peter

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Last Thanksgiving, we were in the midst of Trump’s first year back in
office. Now, ICE is continuing to terrorize our communities and
devastating budget cuts are taking effect, harming working class families.
A path to victory was not clear, and it would have been easy to give in to
despair.

Instead of giving up, we are doing what we always do: put working people
at the center of our work, recruit candidates from and for the working
class, and build the political power our communities deserve.

Just one year later, our movement has come further than the pundits
thought possible. We backed candidates all across the country running on
true progressive values—many of whom were disregarded as long shots—and
elected them in the face of massive spending from our opponents.

Across the country candidates like Melat Kiros in Colorado, Angela
Gonzales-Torres in California, Darializa Avila Chevalier in New York, and
Chris Rabb in Pennsylvania won their races helping nearly double the size
of our bloc in Congress.

This Thanksgiving season, we are taking a moment to say how grateful we
are to you. Together, we stood up to AIPAC, crypto, AI, and the
establishment to elect a new generation of progressive champions who will
bring working class voices to Congress.

The victories we've won this year are just the beginning. The work ahead
is to build on this momentum and elect more working-class champions.

We're so thankful for people like you who’ve helped us get this far.

From our team to you and your family, Happy Thanksgiving!

More soon,

– Justice Democrats

name: Democrats.org
subject: Next Thanksgiving…
body:
We need to make sure that Dems have delivered real relief for American families. [ ](https://ak.democrats.org/go/98055?t=1&akid=10380%2E22930333%2EurhE-R)
---
Derek, Every Thanksgiving, we gather with friends and family across political lines to break bread. We know the last couple of years haven’t always been easy — especially with the hardships that too many Americans are facing due to job losses, groceries and childcare prices skyrocketing, and the division that Trump has sowed. Democrats are going to fight so that by this time next year, Congress has delivered real relief for American families. That means passing legislation to bring down the price of groceries and everyday goods, expand affordable healthcare, end Donald Trump’s illegal wars, and lift up hardworking Americans and their families, not billionaires. Even after Democrats’ major victories this year, making lasting change will require building Democratic power from the ground up at the local, state, and national levels. It’ll require electing a Democratic president to the White House who will sign laws to help the American people. And it’ll require that Democrats stay ready to defend our democracy against whatever attacks Donald Trump launches on it next. In less than two years, we’ll have the opportunity to elect a Democratic president who will help America move past the chaos of the MAGA movement. We don’t yet know who our nominee will be, but we know that the DNC will be ready to rally behind them the moment they’re chosen to help them win and lead America forward. **But getting there will take sustained grassroots support and energy.** The work that the DNC does, including registering new Democratic voters, investing over $1 million every month into state Democratic parties, and maintaining our world-class data and tech infrastructure that campaigns rely on, is sustained by grassroots Democrats who chip in during the “off-season.” It’s sustained by folks who chip in a few dollars a month when the media stops covering elections, but our organizing continues. Donors like them allow us to plan ahead and expand our work to have an even bigger impact in future elections. So, as we reflect on and celebrate the incredible victories that Democrats won this year, we want you to know how grateful we are to have you on our team. As we shift our sights to the White House and the 2028 elections, we’re excited for what’s to come and to continue fighting for hardworking Americans with you, Derek. **[DONATE](https://ak.democrats.org/go/89866?c0=em-dnc-november-2026-gfr.9s4leO&amount=7&refcode=em_20261125_10380_fr&t=5&akid=10380%2E22930333%2EurhE-R)** Thank you, The Democrats

clean_body: We need to make sure that Dems have delivered real relief for American families. Derek, Every Thanksgiving, we gather with friends and family across political lines to break bread. We know the last couple of years haven’t always been easy — especially with the hardships that too many Americans are facing due to job losses, groceries and childcare prices skyrocketing, and the division that Trump has sowed. Democrats are going to fight so that by this time next year, Congress has delivered real relief for American families. That means passing legislation to bring down the price of groceries and everyday goods, expand affordable healthcare, end Donald Trump’s illegal wars, and lift up hardworking Americans and their families, not billionaires. Even after Democrats’ major victories this year, making lasting change will require building Democratic power from the ground up at the local, state, and national levels. It’ll require electing a Democratic president to the White House who will sign laws to help the American people. And it’ll require that Democrats stay ready to defend our democracy against whatever attacks Donald Trump launches on it next. In less than two years, we’ll have the opportunity to elect a Democratic president who will help America move past the chaos of the MAGA movement. We don’t yet know who our nominee will be, but we know that the DNC will be ready to rally behind them the moment they’re chosen to help them win and lead America forward. But getting there will take sustained grassroots support and energy. The work that the DNC does, including registering new Democratic voters, investing over $1 million every month into state Democratic parties, and maintaining our world-class data and tech infrastructure that campaigns rely on, is sustained by grassroots Democrats who chip in during the “off-season.” It’s sustained by folks who chip in a few dollars a month when the media stops covering elections, but our organizing continues. Donors like them allow us to plan ahead and expand our work to have an even bigger impact in future elections. So, as we reflect on and celebrate the incredible victories that Democrats won this year, we want you to know how grateful we are to have you on our team. Kilmar Abrego Garcia **[landed in Madrid](https://substack.com/redirect/45909313-ec6e-49a8-a7ec-73f1e7b9cf74?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Tuesday under a court-ordered departure, with plans to eventually travel to Mexico; his attorney called it a "temporary departure," citing potential future pathways to return given his marriage and child who are U.S. citizens.
[| | | | | Secretary Markwayne Mullin
---
@SecMullinDHS
We are DELIGHTED to announce that Kilmar Abrego Garcia has self-deported from the United States to Spain. We promised the American people that this human trafficker, wife beater, gang member, and child predator would not remain in our country. This Salvadoran man will no longer...
| 3:01 AM * Nov 25, 2026 * 859K Views2.83K Replies * 1.76K Reposts * 18.8K Likes
---](https://substack.com/redirect/ddb02585-ef67-4c8b-8958-8bb03404b897?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin and former press secretary Karoline Leavitt celebrated the departure** , maintaining Abrego Garcia is a gang member and criminal threat who paid for his own flight and received no government incentives, with DHS insisting he will never return.
* **The case capped a nearly two-year legal battle** after Abrego Garcia was deported to a Salvadoran maximum-security prison despite a court order barring his removal there, with the administration later attempting to send him to Liberia before his voluntary departure to Spain.

* * *
# **Trump plans to meet Abdul El-Sayed, open to "Trumpcare" branding**
President Donald Trump told The NY Post he'll meet with Sen.-elect Abdul El-Sayed **[to discuss health care](https://substack.com/redirect/e0ed1380-7d83-4c81-b736-967c5443ae1e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , praising El-Sayed's move to rebrand his "Medicare for All" proposal as "Trumpcare" as "very smart" and expressing optimism about finding middle ground.
* **Trump said:** "He's a smart guy,... I know I'll be meeting with him,... Maybe there's some place in the middle that we could go."

[| | | | | Dr. Abdul El-Sayed

@AbdulElSayed
This is a message for @realDonaldTrump . Donald, this is on the table. Guarantee healthcare for every American, from cradle to grave.

* **The shift marks a dramatic tone change from the campaign trail,** when Trump called El-Sayed a "jihadist lunatic" and El-Sayed accused Trump of hateful rhetoric; El-Sayed has said he's open to naming the plan after Trump if it helps get it passed.
* **Trump said he expects to meet frequently with incoming Democratic leaders Chuck Schumer and Hakeem Jeffries,** expressing broader interest in bipartisan deals, while acknowledging Republicans generally oppose single-payer health care due to its high projected costs despite lower out-of-pocket expenses for patients.

* * *
# **Melania Trump reunites more Russian, Ukrainian children with families**
First Lady Melania Trump **[announced the reunification of nine children](https://substack.com/redirect/f64b2933-4d48-4b33-bb81-612edc8f6d74?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with their families Wednesday, marking her seventh such effort and bringing the total to 43 children reunited amid the ongoing Russia-Ukraine war, achieved with cooperation from both countries' leaders.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f64b2933-4d48-4b33-bb81-612edc8f6d74?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **The reunification follows her recent role in securing a "localized ceasefire" in Ukraine's Kherson region,** which the White House credits with saving nearly 800 lives and enabling delivery of food, water, and medical aid.
* **Melania framed the effort as part of a broader humanitarian mission to bring peace through children,** saying reunification moves the world closer to healing. The announcement came amid a busy holiday schedule, including the White House Christmas tree unveiling and the annual turkey pardon, ahead of the Trumps' trip to Mar-a-Lago for Thanksgiving.

* * *
# **US economy revised up to 4.3% growth in third quarter - Fastest growth in 3 years**
The Bureau of Economic Analysis sharply **[revised third-quarter GDP growth upward](https://substack.com/redirect/e6403232-bc0f-4c24-903b-521aba4291e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to a 4.3% annual rate, well above the initial 3.4% estimate and nearly double the second quarter's 2.2% pace, exceeding even the most optimistic economist forecasts.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e6403232-bc0f-4c24-903b-521aba4291e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Consumer spending rose 4.2%,** driven by higher outlays on prescription drugs, software, and gasoline, while business fixed investment surged 16.1%, fueled by strong equipment spending and revised software price data; housing investment declined 3.4%.
* **Inventory buildup added 1.64 percentage points to growth,** while trade subtracted 3.21 points as imports outpaced exports. Real gross domestic income also jumped to 4.4%, up sharply from 2.3% the previous quarter.

the same social media feeds where right-wing lies spread fastest.

| | Happy Thanksgiving! Here is a little Holiday-themed throwback for you...back during my days as a TV News Anchor, I showed the people of Pennsylvania how to make my famous smashed potatoes. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/144032330/662203232/1018104031?source=JS_EM_FR_112626_B1_Potatoes_Res2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3MTMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTE3ZjlkMGMtZTJlOC1mMTExLTkxZjMtMDAwZDNhNTMzMTliIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=7YQq_ukIOqyV8Z5W8u9T5U6OWqi4k9QvZTEZfPxYjf4=) I always say you can never have too many potatoes at a Thanksgiving table! From what tastes good to what feels good, smashed potatoes are my ultimate comfort food. And they're a crowd pleaser. Hopefully, my recipe will help you wow your crowd this holiday season!
1. Take the biggest potatoes you can find. I like to use Idaho potatoes! You are going to wash and peel them, and then toss those babies in a pot to boil with a bunch of salt.
2. Once they are boiled, strain them, and then get them right back into the hot pot you boiled them in. Add some butter and a little olive oil, and set them aside.
3. In a saucepan, add some chicken bouillon and water or chicken stock, a whole lot of garlic cloves, celery salt, celery seed, and, for a little kick, some cayenne pepper.
4. Once those ingredients are heated and combined, pour the mixture over the potatoes and add some sour cream and a little milk.
5. The final step is to smash it together! I like to use a hand masher. It was my grandmother's, and it does the trick!

Thank you so much for everything that you have done to support our campaign this year. It does not go unnoticed! I am so thankful this holiday season, and every day, that I have such an incredible team working with me. We will deliver better for PA next year. I can't wait to get to work for you. All the best, Janelle [**_P.S. My team and I are already trying to build up our warchest for 2028. As a new frontliner, we will be incredibly vulnerable to the GOP's attacks, but if this election taught us anything, it's that grassroots support matters. If you’d like to unsubscribe, | | Happy Thanksgiving! Here is a little Holiday-themed throwback for you...back during my days as a TV News Anchor, I showed the people of Pennsylvania how to make my famous smashed potatoes. = I always say you can never have too many potatoes at a Thanksgiving table! From what tastes good to what feels good, smashed potatoes are my ultimate comfort food. And they're a crowd pleaser. Hopefully, my recipe will help you wow your crowd this holiday season! 1. Take the biggest potatoes you can find. I like to use Idaho potatoes! You are going to wash and peel them, and then toss those babies in a pot to boil with a bunch of salt. 2. Once they are boiled, strain them, and then get them right back into the hot pot you boiled them in. Add some butter and a little olive oil, and set them aside. 3. In a saucepan, add some chicken bouillon and water or chicken stock, a whole lot of garlic cloves, celery salt, celery seed, and, for a little kick, some cayenne pepper. 4. Once those ingredients are heated and combined, pour the mixture over the potatoes and add some sour cream and a little milk. 5. The final step is to smash it together! I like to use a hand masher. It was my grandmother's, and it does the trick! Thank you so much for everything that you have done to support our campaign this year. It does not go unnoticed! name: Roy Cooper
subject: I just want to say thank you
body:
Soon, the work of governing begins – and I still need you with me.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1663_v2&source=&t=1&akid=5367%2E124072%2Ev6F29Z) | | | | [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1663_v2&amount=5&t=9&akid=5367%2E124072%2Ev6F29Z)
---
Peter,
In the spirit of the season, I’m reaching out to say **thank you**.
Earlier this month, we flipped North Carolina’s U.S. Senate seat blue for the first time in nearly two decades. It happened because grassroots supporters like you were alongside me.
North Carolinians made it clear what kind of future we want to see – and it didn’t just end with our victory. By electing outstanding public servants from the mountains to the coast, our state set the tone for the entire country:
* We flipped the North Carolina House, ending over a decade of one-party control.
* We’re sending 11 strong Democratic members of Congress to the U.S. House, where they’ll be my colleagues.
* On top of that, we reelected Justice Earls to the Supreme Court and our slate of judges to the Court of Appeals, where they will uphold our laws and protect our rights.

**To everyone who chipped in, knocked doors and voted to power these amazing wins, I am so grateful for you!**
That said, the real work is just beginning.
I ran to make stuff cost less, fix what’s broken in Washington DC and return power to the hands of the people. That will be my goal when I’m sworn in in January, but with President Trump still in office, we know we will have obstacles.
**At the end of the day, though, I believe we will make real progress as we aim toward the 2028 elections. I am still a prisoner of hope.** Because I have supporters like you on this team, we were able to achieve what most people thought was impossible here in North Carolina. That’s why I’m confident that if you stick with me through the fights ahead, then no matter the challenges that confront us in Washington, nothing is beyond our reach.
Thank you again for believing in me. I hope you and yours enjoy a happy and hearty Thanksgiving.
Roy Cooper
| | **👋 _One last thing before you go!_**
---
This is a historic moment for Democrats, and we’ve secured a powerful mandate heading into 2027.
We’re ready to make stuff cost less, improve the lives of working people and hold Trump and the GOP accountable over the final two years of his presidency – **but to win the big battles ahead, we still need you on our team.**
[**_Will you please consider a contribution to power the fights ahead so Roy can deliver meaningful results for you and your family?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1663_v2&amount=5&t=10&akid=5367%2E124072%2Ev6F29Z)
| |
* * *
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1663_v2&t=2&akid=5367%2E124072%2Ev6F29Z)
Roy Cooper was born and raised in North Carolina, and he’s spent his life in public service fighting to improve the lives of ordinary people. He’s a former state legislator, Attorney General and Governor – and come January 2027, he will serve as North Carolina’s next U.S. Senator.

After flipping this crucial seat to Democrats for the first time in nearly 20 years, Roy is ready to roll up his sleeves and get to work to stop the chaos in Washington DC, and most importantly, make real progress for working families.

Roy will need grassroots supporters like you with him every step of the way. **So if you can, make a donation to ensure Roy can keep up the fight in the U.S. Senate.**

subject: What we accomplished, together
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Forward Together PAC
body:
This grassroots team has a lot to be proud of

|
---

| | Derek, I wanted to reach out and express something I don’t say nearly enough:

_Thank you._

Because of this grassroots team’s support, Virginia Democrats had a BIG year. #### The Price Tag
## **The Fed 's favorite inflation gauge runs hotter, and a December hike draws closer**
_Incomes rose in October. Spending, once prices are counted, did not._
Our partner above is making a bold call about where artificial intelligence takes markets by the end of the month. The number that moved first this morning came from a far plainer place: a Commerce Department spreadsheet.
[The government's October price report](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6a012b10-5037-45a1-8c9f-b9803dfe1ccc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) showed the price index the Federal Reserve watches most closely up 3.8 percent from a year earlier, after 3.6 percent in September. Core prices, which leave out food and energy, rose 3.3 percent, up from 3.1 percent and a tenth of a point above what forecasters expected. On a monthly basis, core prices rose 0.3 percent for the second month in a row.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6930d8d8-4acc-43ca-8981-20b3d1ed4f0f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Incomes did their part. Personal income jumped 0.7 percent in the month, yet once prices are counted, [household spending slipped slightly](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4ba32e28-45a7-4eeb-9ab7-984fe0ea0e9f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
That leaves the Fed in an awkward spot two weeks before its final meeting of the year on Dec. 8-9. It raised rates in September for the first time in more than three years, and traders already saw another quarter-point move in December as the likely outcome. A hike would carry the prime rate up with it, and the prime rate is what most credit cards and home equity lines are priced from.
I read the flat spending figure as the line to watch: when people earn more and buy less, they are telling you how much they trust next month's prices.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/7c2a6034-cf30-4800-b99c-e48b9192d3ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

#### The January Check
**Medicare 's 2027 bill rises $6.50, and this time the raise covers it**
Medicare has set its numbers for 2027, and they land with the first Social Security deposit of the year. For the first time since 2023, the Part B premium is rising more slowly than the cost-of-living adjustment. Part B covers doctor visits and outpatient care, and for most people the premium is taken straight out of the Social Security benefit.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/18f07c03-9289-43b4-9a7b-265065779e1e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* The standard Part B premium climbs $6.50 to $209.40 a month, and the annual deductible rises $9 to $292, according to [Medicare's official notice](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/c0328841-01d3-4a4a-ba3a-3833b76c9048?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* Social Security's 3.6 percent raise adds about $75 a month for the average retired worker, which leaves [roughly $68.50 after Medicare](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/f95ed0a3-d51d-441a-939b-f194f78905a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* Higher earners pay more: single filers with 2025 income above $112,000 owe at least $293.10 a month for Part B.
* Open enrollment for Medicare Advantage and drug plans closes Dec. 7, the last easy window to compare coverage before the new prices start.

The two changes meet on a single line of the January benefit statement, and for the average retired worker that line ends up about $68 a month higher.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/0bac430c-e426-496a-8862-5d589c0f40ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
#### One Number
**$3.61** was the national average for a gallon of regular on Tuesday, according to [AAA's daily price tracker](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/39a56e93-4465-41e2-b8b1-39b086c943f9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), about 68 cents cheaper than a month ago. On a 15-gallon fill-up, that is roughly $10 back for the drive to Thanksgiving dinner. Gas still costs more than 50 cents a gallon above a year ago, so the relief is real but partial.
#### Why I Led Here
I put inflation on top because this morning's report is the last big one the Fed sees before it decides in two weeks, and that decision reaches most card balances and home equity lines in the country. The saving rate of 4.1 percent is the figure I keep coming back to.
What I honestly cannot tell yet is which gives way first, prices or shoppers. If it is shoppers, the Fed may not need to push as long as the headlines suggest, and I would rather keep some dry powder in cash than guess wrong in either direction.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/9926b29c-4d3a-4b0a-9826-da4f3c74820d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b220382d-fba0-4f1c-acf1-64f0f22ddd78?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---

**YOUR THANKSGIVING POLITICAL SURVIVAL GUIDE**
_Three courses. Three talking points. Zero guarantees of a drama-free dinner._
**COURSE #1: THE APPETIZER**
**Your uncle says: “The Democrats have gone way too far left!”**
**Your response:** Tell him about **Sen.-elect Mary Peltola,** who just won a U.S. Senate seat in Alaska — a state that voted for Donald Trump in 2024.
Mary's campaign wasn't about partisan politics. It was about making life better for working Alaskans. She traveled across the state by plane, boat, and snowmachine, listening to voters and talking about the issues that matter most to them: affordable groceries, good-paying jobs, and protecting Alaska's fishing industry.
Her message? Put Alaska first. And voters agreed.

**COURSE #2: THE MAIN COURSE**
**Your brother-in-law says: “Democrats just want to raise our taxes!”**
**Your response:** Pass the potatoes, and tell him about **Governor Katie Hobbs** , who just won reelection in the battleground state of Arizona.
In her first term, Katie cut taxes for working families, eliminated the state's rental tax, and helped cancel medical debt for nearly 700,000 Arizonans.
Now, with a brand new Democratic trifecta, she's ready to keep fighting to make life more affordable for Arizona families.
Turns out, Democrats know a thing or two about putting money back in people's pockets.

**COURSE #3: DESSERT**
**Your cousin says: “Democrats are weak on national security!”**
**Your response:** Before anybody starts arguing over the last slice of pie, remind them that voters just sent a historic group of women veterans to Congress.
Women like **JoAnna Mendoza (AZ-06), Jessica Killin (CO-05), Rebecca Bennett (NJ-07), Cait Conley (NY-17), Kristina Knickerbocker (OH-10), Nancy Lacore (SC-01), and Elaine Luria (VA-02)**.
These EMILYs List women have served our country in uniform. Now, they're bringing that same commitment to service, leadership, and protecting Americans to the halls of Congress.
And that's something everyone at the table can be thankful for.

**We can't guarantee a drama-free Thanksgiving.** But regardless, because of supporters like you, we have plenty to be thankful for this year.
Across the country, EMILYs List women won because they offered voters a vision of a safer, more affordable future — one that puts people ahead of politics.
**And with your continued support, we'll keep recruiting, training, and electing Democratic pro-choice women who are ready to deliver for ALL Americans.**

clean_body: Consider this our way of giving thanks. | = Hey there Peter, If your Thanksgiving dinner looks anything like ours, it's got turkey, pumpkin pie, and a healthy side of political debate. Democrats delivered a historic blue wave this election, and that means your Republican relatives just might deliver historic arguments across the table. So consider this our way of giving thanks for your support: our guide to navigating those annoying political Thanksgiving dinner arguments. These talking points all come from real electoral victories that you made happen. EMILYs List women ran on governing for all Americans, no matter their party — and now, they're ready to deliver. = | = YOUR THANKSGIVING POLITICAL SURVIVAL GUIDE Three courses. Three talking points. Zero guarantees of a drama-free dinner. COURSE #1: THE APPETIZER Your uncle says: “The Democrats have gone way too far left!” Your response: Tell him about Sen.-elect Mary Peltola, who just won a U.S. Senate seat in Alaska — a state that voted for Donald Trump in 2024. Mary's campaign wasn't about partisan politics. It was about making life better for working Alaskans. She traveled across the state by plane, boat, and snowmachine, listening to voters and talking about the issues that matter most to them: affordable groceries, good-paying jobs, and protecting Alaska's fishing industry. Her message? Put Alaska first. And voters agreed. COURSE #2: THE MAIN COURSE Your brother-in-law says: “Democrats just want to raise our taxes!” Your response: Pass the potatoes, and tell him about Governor Katie Hobbs , who just won reelection in the battleground state of Arizona. In her first term, Katie cut taxes for working families, eliminated the state's rental tax, and helped cancel medical debt for nearly 700,000 Arizonans. Now, with a brand new Democratic trifecta, she's ready to keep fighting to make life more affordable for Arizona families. Turns out, Democrats know a thing or two about putting money back in people's pockets. COURSE #3: DESSERT Your cousin says: “Democrats are weak on national security!” Your response: Before anybody starts arguing over the last slice of pie, remind them that voters just sent a historic group of women veterans to Congress. Women like JoAnna Mendoza (AZ-06), Jessica Killin (CO-05), Rebecca Bennett (NJ-07), Cait Conley (NY-17), Kristina Knickerbocker (OH-10), Nancy Lacore (SC-01), and Elaine Luria (VA-02). These EMILYs List women have served our country in uniform. Now, they're bringing that same commitment to service, leadership, and protecting Americans to the halls of Congress. And that's something everyone at the table can be thankful for. We can't guarantee a drama-free Thanksgiving. But regardless, because of supporters like you, we have plenty to be thankful for this year. Across the country, EMILYs List women won because they offered voters a vision of a safer, more affordable future — one that puts people ahead of politics. And with your continued support, we'll keep recruiting, training, and electing Democratic pro-choice women who are ready to deliver for ALL Americans. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue, your donation will go through immediately: = | = ---|--- = | = = | = We're thankful for your support today and always. — the EMILYs List team | = | | | | | ---|---|---|---|--- Thank you for being a supporter of EMILYs List. Hey folks,
Donald Trump is picking a fight with Mitch McConnell, and the whole thing is a perfect example of what's broken in Washington.
Republicans are racing to confirm Trump's last-minute nominees before Democrats take control of the Senate, but McConnell's office is reportedly holding up one of Trump's picks. And the story behind it is an absolute mess.
We've got MAGA infighting, political favors, an aging political establishment, and a Republican Party that seems more interested in rewarding its friends than addressing the problems Americans are facing.
Here's what we get into:
* [**00:00:27**] Trump takes a shot at Mitch McConnell on Truth Social as a fight over a key nomination exposes tensions inside the Republican Party.
* [**00:03:06**] Who is Nate Morris? We break down how Trump pushed the Kentucky Senate candidate out of the race and offered him an ambassadorship.
* [**00:05:00**] Morris's campaign attacks on McConnell come back into focus as his nomination runs into resistance.
* [**00:08:41**] Republicans face a shrinking window to confirm Trump's nominees before Democrats take control of the Senate in January.
* [**00:11:35**] Why this fight is about something much bigger: Washington's aging leadership, political corruption, affordability, and the need for a new generation of public servants.

Here's what really matters to me: **Corruption and affordability are connected.** When Washington spends its time handing out political favors and fighting over who gets which powerful job, working families are left wondering why nobody is doing anything about their healthcare costs, housing, groceries, or wages.
And this isn't just a Republican problem. Democrats have their own responsibility to confront the political establishment, demand transparency, and prove that winning elections actually means making people's lives better.
We have an opportunity to build a new generation of leadership that understands what Americans are going through. But that means holding both parties accountable and refusing to accept business as usual.
That's the work we're committed to at Endless Urgency. If you value independent media that calls out corruption, challenges the powerful, and keeps the focus on working people, help me keep these conversations going.

subject: Thank you, Peter
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20261125-1&t=1&akid=4263%2E587540%2EDBHUSs)
Peter,
Before we all (hopefully) log off for the holiday, I want to say something I don’t think I can say enough:
**_THANK YOU._**
Last Thanksgiving, I told you how Leaders We Deserve started: with a dream, a lot of risk, and the $5 I put into our ActBlue to make sure it worked. A year later, I can tell you that dream just had its best year yet.
This year, we endorsed 55 candidates across the country, the most in our organization’s history. **And after Election Day, 36 of them have won.** These are young visionaries who’ll now be sitting in state legislatures and Congress because you believed in the next generation of leaders.
Our candidates were also part of something bigger. This November, Democrats won a historic victory up and down the ballot, including in places people had written off for decades. And our generation helped make it happen: we organized, we turned out, and we ran for office ourselves. I really believe this moment can put our country on a better track. If it does, it’ll be because people like you decided not to give up on it.
When we started this organization, I said we were trying to give our generation something it had rarely had: hope. Hope that our government could work for the people instead of the special interests it’s supposed to protect us from. Hope that when our generation finally took power, we wouldn’t just be younger versions of the leaders who failed us.
This year, that hope started to look a lot more like results.
**And none of that would’ve happened without you, Peter.**
Every candidate we trained, every race we showed up for, and every win we celebrated on Election Night traces back to people like you who chipped in, shared our work, and kept believing even when the odds looked long.
So wherever you are this week, whether you’re with family or chosen family, or just catching some well-deserved rest, I hope you know how thankful I am to be in this fight with you.
We have so much more to do, and I can’t wait to do it together. Happy Thanksgiving!
With gratitude today and every day,
David

| | I'm thankful for a lot this year. But at the top of the list, it has to be how **our democracy continues to prevail.** And it continues to prevail because of _you._ Over the last two years, you refused to give in to fear. You stood steadfast to defend our core values. You never stopped working to create positive change in your communities — and you never let the intimidation efforts of the Trump administration deter you. **You helped lay the groundwork for a momentous election that has put a critical check on Trump's authoritarianism, given us a real opportunity for accountability, and opened the door to reset our politics and advance progress.** At a time when our democracy was pushed to the brink, you believed in its possibilities. You fought for our core values. And those values were strengthened on Election Day in ways that will reverberate for years to come. subject: Happy Thanksgiving, friend! 🦃
body:
|
#
Happy Thanksgiving, friend! 🦃 I hope you and your loved ones are able to rest, relax, and enjoy lots of good food and fun. Between Thanksgiving dinner and the holiday rush, my family and I have been taking the time to reflect on what we’re most thankful for this year. It’s a simple tradition, but it always reminds me to appreciate the little things in life and the special people who make it meaningful – **like you all.** Thanks to everyone who chipped in, gave their time, and spread our message throughout the district, I get to keep fighting for our community – and for that, I’m so grateful. It’s been the greatest honor of my life to be able to serve mid-Michigan – and I’m excited to continue this work. But for now, I’ll be enjoying this time with my family – and I hope you do the same! Thank you, Kristen

The redwoods are stronger because of you| | |
---
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/144049720/662247524/779512579?sourceid=1171062&ms=EM2&utm_campaign=K2D-1171062&utm_source=ea-fundraising&utm_medium=email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjAzMGQ0ZTRmLWY2ZTgtZjExMS05MWYzLTAwMGQzYTUzMzE5YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=02cbB_rxkTDtwU9IAoKxD3llehePgw0BhuVQLnfplTY=&emci=57563e0a-cfe2-f111-91f3-000d3a533978&emdi=030d4e4f-f6e8-f111-91f3-000d3a53319b&ceid=1504551)

| | | Peter:
---
This week, many of us will be gathering with loved ones, sharing good food, and reflecting on what we’re most thankful for. As Senior Manager of Community Engagement for Save the Redwoods League, one of the things I’m most grateful for this year is _you_. **Redwood forests are strongest when the communities around them are strong, and your support helps make that possible.** Here’s a glimpse of how your generosity directly supports local redwoods communities:
---
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/144049721/662247525/-98340765?sourceid=1171062&ms=EM2&utm_campaign=K2D-1171062&utm_source=ea-fundraising&utm_medium=email&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjAzMGQ0ZTRmLWY2ZTgtZjExMS05MWYzLTAwMGQzYTUzMzE5YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=02cbB_rxkTDtwU9IAoKxD3llehePgw0BhuVQLnfplTY=&emci=57563e0a-cfe2-f111-91f3-000d3a533978&emdi=030d4e4f-f6e8-f111-91f3-000d3a53319b&ceid=1504551)
---
**Redwood Rides:** For many people, the biggest barrier to the redwoods is simply getting there. Redwood Rides provides free transportation to nearby redwood parks for communities across the Bay Area. For many riders, it’s their first time standing beneath a redwood tree.
---
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/144049722/662247526/-98340765?sourceid=1171062&ms=EM2&utm_campaign=K2D-1171062&utm_source=ea-fundraising&utm_medium=email&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjAzMGQ0ZTRmLWY2ZTgtZjExMS05MWYzLTAwMGQzYTUzMzE5YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=02cbB_rxkTDtwU9IAoKxD3llehePgw0BhuVQLnfplTY=&emci=57563e0a-cfe2-f111-91f3-000d3a533978&emdi=030d4e4f-f6e8-f111-91f3-000d3a53319b&ceid=1504551)
---
**Redwoods Rising:** This one-of-a-kind initiative is breathing life back into severely damaged forests within Redwood National and State Parks and supporting the surrounding communities at the same time. By injecting dollars into local economies and providing well-paying restoration jobs in an area with high unemployment, we’re creating a sustainable restoration economy.
---
[ ](https://click.everyaction.com/k/144049723/662247527/-98340765?sourceid=1171062&ms=EM2&utm_campaign=K2D-1171062&utm_source=ea-fundraising&utm_medium=email&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjAzMGQ0ZTRmLWY2ZTgtZjExMS05MWYzLTAwMGQzYTUzMzE5YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=02cbB_rxkTDtwU9IAoKxD3llehePgw0BhuVQLnfplTY=&emci=57563e0a-cfe2-f111-91f3-000d3a533978&emdi=030d4e4f-f6e8-f111-91f3-000d3a53319b&ceid=1504551)
---
**Tribal Partnerships:** Tribes and Indigenous communities have stewarded the redwoods since time immemorial. Save the Redwoods works in partnership with multiple Tribes across the redwood range, utilizing their expertise and perspectives to restore redwood ecosystems.
---
All of this work and more happens because of people like you, who believe the redwoods belong to everyone. Thank you for being part of this incredible community.
---
| | |
---
| | With gratitude,
---
Leslie ParraSenior Manager of Community Engagement
---

clean_body: The redwoods are stronger because of you| | | | | | Peter: This week, many of us will be gathering with loved ones, sharing good food, and reflecting on what we’re most thankful for. As Senior Manager of Community Engagement for Save the Redwoods League, one of the things I’m most grateful for this year is you. Redwood forests are strongest when the communities around them are strong, and your support helps make that possible. Here’s a glimpse of how your generosity directly supports local redwoods communities: Redwood Rides: For many people, the biggest barrier to the redwoods is simply getting there. Redwood Rides provides free transportation to nearby redwood parks for communities across the Bay Area. For many riders, it’s their first time standing beneath a redwood tree. Redwoods Rising: This one-of-a-kind initiative is breathing life back into severely damaged forests within Redwood National and State Parks and supporting the surrounding communities at the same time. By injecting dollars into local economies and providing well-paying restoration jobs in an area with high unemployment, we’re creating a sustainable restoration economy. Tribal Partnerships: Tribes and Indigenous communities have stewarded the redwoods since time immemorial. Save the Redwoods works in partnership with multiple Tribes across the redwood range, utilizing their expertise and perspectives to restore redwood ecosystems. All of this work and more happens because of people like you, who believe the redwoods belong to everyone. Thank you for being part of this incredible community. | | | | | With gratitude, Leslie ParraSenior Manager of Community Engagement | | | Help restore and protect the redwoods | | | Save the Redwoods League 220 Montgomery St, Suite 350San Francisco, CA 94104United States CONNECT WITH US | | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|--- |

name: George Whitesides
subject: Wishing you a Happy Thanksgiving, Peter!
body:
Happy Thanksgiving, Peter!

I have a lot to be grateful for this year.

I’m thankful to the people of the Antelope Valley, Santa Clarita Valley, and San Fernando Valley for trusting me with a second term. Serving this community is the honor of my lifetime.

I’m thankful for my wife and kids, who’ve put up with two years of cross-country flights and one more campaign. I suspect they’re most thankful the ads are finally off the air.

I’m thankful for our casework team, who helped return over $15 million in federal benefits that seniors, veterans, and local businesses were owed.

And I’m thankful for you, Peter. Every door knocked, every dollar chipped in, and every conversation with a neighbor added up to a win in one of the toughest races in the country.

In January, I’ll head back to Washington as part of a new Democratic majority, focused on lowering costs and holding this administration accountable. I don’t take your support for granted, and I’m glad to have you with me for what comes next.

Wishing you and your loved ones a happy Thanksgiving.

Thank you,

Find local food assistance and ways to support Northwest Washington families this holiday season.
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/144049409/662246474/-201694504?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwODIxN2U3NS1mNWU4LWYxMTEtOTFmMy0wMDBkM2E1MzMxOWIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0BKVXdQsWDZkN6-Eq4st_uk2Yf2eKfHDtKD-oy2YZh8=&emci=3057bb91-dbe8-f111-91f3-000d3a53319b&emdi=08217e75-f5e8-f111-91f3-000d3a53319b&ceid=9494239)
