clean_body: Recipe inside!| | | | = Peter, say all you want about pie, I’m not afraid to admit that my favorite Thanksgiving food is actually the cinnamon pull-aparts I make every year. My great-aunt Jessie taught me how to make them. There’s nothing better than enjoying a warm, buttery cinnamon roll (among other dishes!) together while we go around the table and share what each of us is grateful for — another of my favorite Thanksgiving traditions. This year there is so much to be thankful for, coming off incredible November elections and looking ahead to the progress I know we can make together next year and beyond. And having spent many holidays over the years working at the hospital or on call, I never take for granted the opportunity to be with John and our kids on Thanksgiving. From my fellow healthcare providers to service industry professionals to first responders to military service members, there are many Americans who will spend Thanksgiving keeping the rest of us safe, healthy, and fed. To everyone working or serving away from loved ones this holiday — I see you, and I am so thankful for all you do. I hope that no matter how you’re spending tomorrow, you get a moment to connect with someone you love. (And before we sign off for the holiday, I have to know: What’s your controversial favorite Thanksgiving food?! Reply and let me know — bonus points if you share the recipe!)From my family to yours, wishing you a happy and healthy Thanksgiving.Kelly | | | = Congresswoman Kelly Morrison Minnesota’s 3rd DistrictP.S. name: Marilyn
subject: Happy Thanksgiving
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Strickland for Washington
body:
Thank you, and the work still ahead -

---
| | Good morning,

This Thanksgiving, I'm thinking about the people who made this year possible: the neighbors who knocked on doors, the volunteers who made calls, and the supporters who chipped in when it counted. Thank you. Your belief in this community is what drives me every day.

Families across our district are still facing the cost of housing and everyday expenses, and too many people are still worried about their health care, their safety and their right to vote. That work doesn't pause for the holiday, and neither does my commitment to it.

For today, I hope you're around a table with people you love, and that you take a moment to rest. We'll pick the work back up together.

Wishing you and yours a warm and happy Thanksgiving.

Marilyn

| | |
---
I'm thankful for the hard-working campaign team that brought us over the finish line. I'm thankful for my loving husband, Bob, and for my legislative staff who held it down in HD-47 while I was on the road for two years winning a statewide election!

I'm also thankful for the women who paved the way. Barbara Jordan's portrait hangs in the Senate chamber, across from Opal Lee. I don't take for granted whose shoulders I'm standing on, or the responsibility we have to the women who come after us.

Vikki GoodwinLieutenant Governor-Elect of Texas

body:
Thank you for being part of what makes San Diego home.
---
| | Hey Peter, I am home and preparing to celebrate one of our favorite holidays, Thanksgiving. This year, I have so much to be grateful for. For the San Diegans who voted to send me back to Congress to fight for our values - thank you. For the _blue-nami_ that washed across the entire country, restoring our Democratic majority in both the House and Senate. Voters made history across the nation - electing the most diverse Congress ever and we are preparing for the first ever African-American Speaker and our first transgender member of leadership. This is the change we promised and I can’t wait for what’s next. I know that none of this was possible without people like you. You made calls. You talked to voters. You donated. You made sure your friends and family voted. None of this is easy and I'm so grateful for your dedication to our democracy and to this community. **Thank you.** **I hope you have a happy and safe holiday. From my family to yours, Happy Thanksgiving.** I’ll be in touch again soon. Your Congressman, Scott

body:
| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/144065906/662285339/-975735282?refcode=em_logoheader&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNGRkODYzNi0yM2U5LWYxMTEtOTFmMy0wMDBkM2E1MzMxOWIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qESDgQFMY0fULxPIkO6JpJqY5bJIvrq8Kc_CyVzOFzk=)

Peter, Happy almost-Thanksgiving!

I wanted to tell you how deeply grateful I am for your support in this campaign and that I get the honor of working for you in Congress.

They say no man is an island, and I couldn't agree more. None of us gets where we are alone. I know I certainly wouldn't be where I am today without the love, sacrifices, and support of the people who've stood beside me, starting with my family.
Thanksgiving has always been one of my favorite days because it brings me back to the heart of my childhood. Growing up, we didn't have much. But every year, both my grandmas and all my cousins would pack into our double-wide trailer, squeezing around a kitchen table that somehow always managed to fit everyone. My mom would be up at 4 a.m. making the full spread — turkey, stuffing, collard greens, pan-baked cornbread, acre peas, and my favorite... _chocolate cream pie_. What we lacked in space or money, we made up for in love. No matter what struggles weighed on us, once we gathered around that table, all that mattered was each other.

Throughout this campaign, I've met so many people who brought me back to those Thanksgivings growing up. I've sat down with parents who work tirelessly, just as mine did, hoping to give their children opportunities they never had. I've met seniors with hopes for a brighter future, students eager to make their mark on the world, and families who dream of a better life for the people they love.

As I look ahead to serving in Congress, I promise I will carry those conversations with me. I will never forget where I came from or the people who helped me get here. And I will never lose sight of the families and communities who are counting on me to fight for them.

I hope you and your loved ones have a wonderful, peaceful Thanksgiving tomorrow, full of laughs and the most delicious food!

— Christina
Christina Bohannan is a mom, law professor, engineer, former state representative, and congresswoman-elect for Iowa's 1st District. She's ready to go to Washington to lower costs for Iowans, fix our broken healthcare system, build a family-friendly economy, and give the people of IA-01 a fair shot to get ahead.

Like so many of you, I am horrified by the stories of ICE agents operating with impunity across our nation, including in American airports. Masked agents are sowing chaos, terrifying travelers and deterring people from exploring our country as tourists or visiting loved ones who live just a plane ride away.
Last Saturday, we saw another such horrific story at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport, when masked ICE agents arrested a father and his adult daughter on a jet bridge. They were on their way to attend a family baptism, but instead, fellow passengers looked on as they were arrested while boarding their flight. Their attorney says both have pending immigration applications and no criminal records. **Washington 's governor says ICE gave neither the airport nor the airline any advance notice.**
Just last summer, we saw similar terror right here in Nevada, when ICE violently attempted to arrest a man at Harry Reid International Airport. They abandoned the arrest but inhumanely left the man handcuffed and helpless.
ICE should not be allowed to operate like this. People should be able to travel freely within America without fear of sudden, violent arrests by masked agents.
**That 's why I just introduced the Travel Without Fear Act, co-sponsored by Senators Alex Padilla and Tammy Duckworth. This bill prohibits ICE from conducting civil enforcement operations at airports without a judicial warrant and sets clear guidelines for their conduct when they have one.**
Here's more of what the Travel Without Fear Act would do:
* Requires a judicial warrant before ICE can carry out civil enforcement operations at airports
* Bans information sharing between ICE and TSA without a judicial warrant
* Blocks ICE from accessing airline passenger data without a warrant
* Requires advance notice to airports and airlines before any enforcement action
* Codifies the online detainee locator and requires it be updated within six hours of any change in custody

In a country that values freedom, we can't allow the president and his Washington cronies to violate people's rights. It's clear that ICE has gotten out of control under Donald Trump, and they need to be reined in - this will remain a priority for me as our new Democratic Senate majority is sworn in.
**Enough is enough. We need guardrails on ICE.**
Thanks for reading,
Jacky

name: Jacky Rosen
subject: I just introduced a bill to rein in ICE
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Rosen for Nevada
body:
| | |
---
Friend,
Over the past year, I’ve watched with horror as ICE has operated with impunity — including inside our nation’s airports, sowing chaos and fear in our communities and scaring away tourists.
Last Saturday, masked ICE agents arrested a father and his adult daughter on a jet bridge at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport as they tried to board an Alaska Airlines flight to attend a family baptism. Their attorney says both have pending immigration applications and no criminal records. **Washington's governor says ICE gave neither the airport nor the airline any advance notice.**
It brought back a recent memory from right here in Nevada, when ICE violently attempted to arrest a man at Harry Reid International Airport this past summer. ICE should not be allowed to operate like this. **That’s why I just introduced a bill to prohibit ICE from conducting civil enforcement operations at airports without a judicial warrant and set clear guidelines for their conduct when they have one.**
**_My bill, the Travel Without Fear Act, is co-sponsored by Sens. Alex Padilla and Tammy Duckworth. Here's what it does:_**
* Requires a judicial warrant before ICE can carry out civil enforcement operations at airports
* Bans information sharing between ICE and TSA without a judicial warrant
* Blocks ICE from accessing airline passenger data without a warrant
* Requires advance notice to airports and airlines before any enforcement action
* Codifies the online detainee locator and requires it be updated within six hours of any change in custody

Donald Trump and Washington Republicans have allowed ICE to operate recklessly and aggressively in our communities, putting lives at risk. No one should have to wonder whether boarding a flight to see family, start a new job, or get home will end in arrest by masked agents. **Enough is enough. ICE needs to be held accountable.**
Thanks for reading,
Jacky

Peter,

Before everyone logs off for the long weekend, Carina and I wanted to take a moment to say thank you.

When this campaign started, I was a public school kid from the Central Valley asking for a shot at taking on a six-term incumbent. This Thanksgiving, I’m writing to you as the Congressman-elect for CA-22, and I still have to read that sentence twice before I believe it.

None of this happens without you. Every dollar you chipped in, every post you shared, every door you knocked, and every time you told a skeptical neighbor this seat was winnable added up to a victory that plenty of people doubted.

My wife Carina deserves her own thank you.

She put up with late nights, a phone that never stopped buzzing, and far more campaign talk at the dinner table than anyone should have to hear.

This week we’re looking forward to spending time with family, overeating my mom’s cooking, and finding out whether being a Member of Congress gets me out of dish duty. (My mom says it does not. 😉)

I’ll have more to share soon as we get ready to head to Washington, but today I just want you to know how grateful we are for you.

From our family to yours, Happy Thanksgiving.

clean_body: | = Peter, Before everyone logs off for the long weekend, Carina and I wanted to take a moment to say thank you. When this campaign started, I was a public school kid from the Central Valley asking for a shot at taking on a six-term incumbent. This Thanksgiving, I’m writing to you as the Congressman-elect for CA-22, and I still have to read that sentence twice before I believe it. None of this happens without you. Every dollar you chipped in, every post you shared, every door you knocked, and every time you told a skeptical neighbor this seat was winnable added up to a victory that plenty of people doubted. My wife Carina deserves her own thank you. She put up with late nights, a phone that never stopped buzzing, and far more campaign talk at the dinner table than anyone should have to hear. This week we’re looking forward to spending time with family, overeating my mom’s cooking, and finding out whether being a Member of Congress gets me out of dish duty. (My mom says it does not. 😉) I’ll have more to share soon as we get ready to head to Washington, but today I just want you to know how grateful we are for you. From our family to yours, Happy Thanksgiving. -Randy | With deep ties to our community and a lifelong commitment to justice and equity, Randy is running for Congress in California’s 22nd District to bring bold, compassionate leadership to Washington. Friend, I penned this message for you myself.

This is important, and I want you to hear it from me directly.

This fall season has been a real wake-up call for our movement.

Outside my Oval Office window, the leaves are turning beautiful reds, golds, and oranges, but another, very different change is also happening in Washington, D.C.

I’ll be honest with you: what happened on Election Night wasn’t what we wanted to see.

It hurt. I know it hurt you too because you’ve put your heart into this. You always have.
Now, across our country, dangerous, Radical Democrats are set to take office in just a few short weeks.

Their agenda is simple and ugly:

DESTROY the American Golden Age that we have built together.

They want to throw open our borders.

Pack the Supreme Court.

Eliminate Voter ID.

_They want to erase everything we fought so hard to protect._

But here is the truth that fills me with fire and gratitude this Thanksgiving season: they have not broken us. Not even close.

And although we have stumbled, we have not been broken - and we will never be broken.

Because our movement is filled with patriots like yourself: those brave Americans who have always stood for our nation even when the going has been tough, when the headlines have turned against us, and when others have walked away.

That kind of loyalty is rare, and it means everything to me.

You are the backbone of the greatest political movement in American history.
And although the leaves outside may be falling, MAGA will remain standing.
So as we begin to travel and gather with our loved ones this Thanksgiving season, I want you to feel two things at once:
1\. This fight is far from over. The Radical Left is more energized - and more dangerous - than ever.

2\. My solemn vow to you: that I will NEVER surrender our fight to Make America Great Again, no matter what they throw at me.

I will still fight for secure borders. I will still fight for free and fair elections. I will still fight for a country that puts America First. I will still fight for the future our children deserve.

Together, we will continue to FIGHT! FIGHT! FIGHT!

This is our time to dig deeper, stand taller, and come back stronger than ever.
Please, if you are financially able, can I count on your support for just $20.27? Your contribution today could be the deciding factor in determining MAGA’s future in 2027.

Thank you & God bless you.
